# Genuine played pop-up weekend fixture (#41)

Captured by the rendered Traditional Chinese `--from=popup` tour after native notice reservation, selection of fifty purchased units, one-hour transfer, checkout action and Sunday settlement. Fixture setup registers a company and capitalizes its bank account; 100 bottles are purchased at $5/unit through the inventory/cash ledger before the UI tour. No revenue is injected.

The short tour controls calendar jumps to the reserved weekend and Sunday closing time; it is UI/flow evidence, not a full economy run. MiniGames.auto=.85 exercises the actual checkout completion callback and actual one-hour simulation. Hand-play checkout uses the same MiniGame framework with basket arithmetic; practice creates no income. The completed report and retained physical stock are persisted in the fixture.
